caption: The drawing consists of a square grid composed of alternating geometric patterns in blue and beige tones. The composition is organized into rows and columns, each filled with various repetitive motifs including rectangles, squares, and bowtie-like shapes arranged in consecutive lines. The uppermost section of the grid primarily features vertical and horizontal segments forming checked and striped patterns, while the middle horizontal rows include a recurring double bowtie motif. The shades of blue are consistently distributed throughout the grid, with some areas filled more densely, producing a darker color. The beige background fills the negative space within the grid and around the colored blocks, maintaining a uniform contrast. The drawing is signed with a handwritten marking in brownish-orange ink in the lower right corner: “Sarkis Izgualian.” The drawing is centered on a plain, cream-colored or light beige paper background, with margins on all four sides.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
